sharedFileOwnership.rule: Only svc-p08 is dispatched. Its writePaths are disjoint from all accepted plan paths, and sharedPaths is empty. The worker edits only its own plan file and Progress Log. It never edits: this manifest, the g1-g7 manifests, impl-plans/README.md, impl-plans/logs/**, README.md, src/**, db/**, or another plan's files. It never runs git checkout, restore, stash, reset, clean, commit, add or push. Per-edit discipline: read the file fresh before each edit; record pre/post SHA-256 hashes and an immutable intent snapshot under the evidence root; check for drift. If an owned file's hash changed outside the worker's own edits, write a Reconciliation request and never overwrite it.
sharedFileOwnership.dependencies: No dependency or lockfile change. Do not run uv lock or edit pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/web/package.json or src/web/bun.lock.
sharedFileOwnership.reconciliation: A defect in production code or in an accepted plan's file is a Reconciliation request in the svc-p08 Progress Log, reproduced by a failing test id. Serial finalization fixes it at the root cause; workers never make cross-plan edits.

reviewContext.userProblem: The owner wants Telescreen, Inventory and Notification each deployable as a microservice, with Inventory and Notification never calling Telescreen. The implementation is done; only the cross-process R1-R8 proof and the full leak matrix remain.
requiredOutcomes: R1R8 (a): stopping Notification or Inventory while Telescreen commits a producer change, then restarting it, applies each command exactly once. Proved by inbox rows, link sequence and notification rows; a redelivery returns duplicate.
R1R8 (b): with the Telescreen API and worker stopped, Inventory serves /api/data/* and its overdue obligation is delivered through Notification to the fake SMTP.

R1R8 (c): after notification-store copy and verify, the copied pending notification is delivered once, and the inventory retention command whose event id matches a copied receipt returns DUPLICATE with no second notification.

The leak matrix enumerates db/ownership.py tables_for for all three stores and scans every row, the process logs, the API bodies, the SMTP DATA and both audit exports. No raw or JSON-escaped sample appears.
mise run ci, ddl-check, web-ci and uv build pass, and the plans and manifests are archived.
nonGoals: No production code, DDL or migration change in svc-p08.
No new multi-process cases for OIDC parity, DLP parity, the settings proxy or collection; existing component and in-process tests cover them (svc-p08 Run 8 Scope).
No live PostgreSQL, Mailpit or Keycloak checks (owner-run).
No re-implementation or redispatch of svc-p01 to svc-p07.
constraints: English only, no emojis. Plans under 400 lines. Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing (typelint, ruff ANN/PGH, ty). No Any, object, dict or **kwargs, and no type-ignore.
Raw detected values, raw item keys and source content never enter any table, log, outbox, replica, wire message, notification, export or API response.
Default uv run pytest passes offline. Process tests use ephemeral ports, bounded polling (at most 90 s), append-mode logs and termination in finally.
Conventions 7a: only final passing commands; priorVerification empty; addressedFeedback only fixed findings.
Commit and push only to feat/service-split.
designDecisionsAndRationale: D1-D5 and C1-C9/O1 of design-service-split.md stand unchanged. Inventory and Notification never call Telescreen. Cross-service delivery is at-least-once through durable outboxes and idempotent inbox receipts, so replay after an outage is proved by multi-process TCP tests rather than by in-process fakes.

Run 8 proves R1-R8 with real service processes on ephemeral ports and SQLite stores, which keeps the default offline pytest valid. The leak matrix enumerates db/ownership.py tables_for so that a new store table cannot escape the scan.
svc-p08 changes only tests, docs and compose examples. A production defect becomes a Reconciliation request that serial finalization fixes at the root cause.
intentionalTradeoffs: Process tests wait up to 90 s each (cron minute alignment plus delivery backoff). Flakiness is mitigated by restarting the stopped receiver after the first failed attempt and by the 3x repeat gate.
PostgreSQL restricted-login and live Mailpit/Keycloak checks stay owner-run, because agents have no TELESCREEN_TEST_* variables.
Plan Metadata 'wave: 5' and dependsOn text are left stale until finalization sets Status Completed (review comm-001093, low finding). The manifest wave C with dependsOn [] is authoritative.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Multi-process OIDC parity, DLP parity, the settings proxy and collection flows. Component and in-process tests cover them.
PostgreSQL-backed multi-process runs and live external services.
Split-mode Telescreen startup that refuses a post-copy main.db. This is recorded as a Reconciliation request, not fixed in svc-p08.
supportedEdgeCases: Receiver stopped after the first failed delivery attempt; restart within the backoff window (notification 2**attempt s, inventory 10*2**(attempt-1) s).
Overdue cron fires once per cron minute, so it is enabled only by restarting Inventory after the asset and replica exist.
Copied retention receipt makes the inventory command a DUPLICATE before an inbox claim (notification_service/inbox.py:62-74).
A store table missing from its SQLite file fails the leak matrix.
